data.explanation: This is an invoice for a moving service already performed. You need to pay the total amount of €1,718.36 to the company's account by the deadline shown, which the app calculates from the invoice date. If you don't pay in time, the company may send a reminder (Mahnung) and could add late fees or interest. Check the amount against what was agreed before paying, and keep this invoice for your records — moving costs can sometimes be tax-deductible if the move was for professional reasons (e.g. a new job), so consider consulting a tax advisor.
